name: OmniAuth

evidence.library: F02: embedded Ruby middleware for provider login; F05: developer runs app, accounts and sessions

line: Ruby middleware for adding login through external providers.

free.text: Free MIT middleware; you run it

cells.freeUsers: No licence user cap; you host
cells.sso: No connection licence fee; strategy and IdP setup needed

mau.math: The OmniAuth and strategy software licences cost $0. Your app's accounts, sessions, hosting and running the sign-in providers cost extra.
